    The length function on finitely generated modules #

    Over a ring that is both Noetherian and Artinian, every finitely generated module has finite composition length, and the composition length is a length function on FGModuleCat R in the sense of HasLength. Finite-dimensional algebras over a field are such rings, so this covers mod Λ.
